<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Calculate 66!
factorial_66 = math.factorial(66)
print(f"66! = {factorial_66}")

# Convert to string to get digits
factorial_str = str(factorial_66)
print(f"Number of digits: {len(factorial_str)}")

# Calculate sum of digits
digit_sum = sum(int(digit) for digit in factorial_str)
print(f"Sum of digits: {digit_sum}")

# Show the individual digits for verification
print(f"\nDigits: {' + '.join(factorial_str)} = {digit_sum}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Double-check by calculating digit sum again with different method
factorial_66 = math.factorial(66)
digits = [int(d) for d in str(factorial_66)]
total = sum(digits)

print(f"66! = {factorial_66}")
print(f"Digits list: {digits}")
print(f"Digit sum: {total}")

# Verify: sum of all individual digits
verification = 0
for i, d in enumerate(digits):
    verification += d
print(f"Verification sum: {verification}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
